name: Race Track Mayhem
description: A toy-car racing game for kids. Pick one of five toy cars and race around six tracks set up in giant rooms of the house (the bedroom, playroom, kitchen, bathroom and living room) and out in the garden. Loop-de-loops, corkscrews, spiral climbs, a giant jump over the pond, boost pads and a Ready, Set, GO! countdown. Grand Prix cups, 2-player split screen, unlockable paint jobs and a secret car. Keyboard or game controller.
requirements: Graphics that support OpenGL 3.3 (almost any PC from the last 10 years)
Keyboard, or an Xbox-style game controller
